agents.mode.missing.codex: The current Codex integration does not yet connect App Server approvals to Terminus. Only automatic mode is available for now.
agents.mode.missing.antigravity.manual: Antigravity doesn't return approvals: what it emits while working has no way to ask for permission, and it doesn't read replies.
agents.mode.missing.antigravity.edits: Antigravity accepts edits, but it doesn't ask permission for commands: it denies them on its own and ends the turn with no answer and no reason.
agents.command.clash.picker: {command} wasn't sent: the model and the reasoning level are chosen in the composer's model picker.
agents.command.clash.session: {command} wasn't sent: it resets the {agent} session, and this conversation would no longer match it. To start over, open another task.
agents.command.clash.account_settings: {command} wasn't sent: it writes the {agent} account settings, which all its tasks share.
agents.command.clash.writes_home: {command} wasn't sent: it writes a memory dump of about 20 MB to your home folder.
